en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a city square or broad avenue in the background with a park-like setting and distant multi‑storey buildings with spires. In the foreground, a young child in early‑20th‑century clothing stands holding a large bouquet of flowers; this figure appears to be a studio photograph composited onto the city view. At the bottom there is a printed caption in a Scandinavian language followed by smaller publisher text.
